findings.title: Pervasive multiple-dependent-claim-on-multiple-dependent-claim defect across 56 claims
findings.attack: Each cited claim multiply depends on a range including an already multiply-dependent claim, contrary to 37 CFR 1.75(c), Rule 43(4) EPC and the aligned UK rule.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Restructure the affected claims' back-reference ranges (split or renumber) so no multiple dependent claim depends on another multiple dependent claim; no narrowing of scope required.

findings.title: Antecedent basis gap for "bears" in claim 28
findings.attack: "a side on which the poppet bears in over-travel" has no antecedent when claim 28 depends from claim 1 alone, since only claim 2 recites "bears."
findings.least_narrowing_action: Replace "bears" with language tracking claim 1's own vocabulary (contact producing the radial deflection), or restrict claim 28's dependency to claim 2 and its dependents.

findings.title: Reference numeral (30) conflict between genus claim 1 and species claim 9
findings.attack: Claim 1's genus "deflectable ring element" is numbered (30), the seat ring's own numeral, conflicting with claim 9's equally valid wiper-ring species numbered (132).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Delete the numeral from claim 1's genus recitation; retain numerals only on the narrowing species claims.

findings.title: Claim 64 preamble conflicts with the description's definition of "inflatable chamber"
findings.attack: [0025] defines inflatable chamber as the internal volume of the tube, not the tube itself, but claim 64 treats it as the physical article comprising the tube.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Broaden [0025]'s definition to also cover the physical article, or amend claim 64 to the volume-based reading.

findings.title: Cross-category incorporation of other claims by number within claims 61, 89 and 99
findings.attack: Limitations incorporate entire alternative claim ranges (themselves containing F-37-1 defects) as claim features rather than as formal dependencies, compounding indefiniteness.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Retain the construction once the incorporated ranges are cleaned up under F-37-1; no independent narrowing needed.

findings.title: Relative term "about" in claim 44
findings.attack: "about" remains a term of degree inviting an EPO Art. 84 clarity objection despite [0007]'s definition.
findings.least_narrowing_action: No pre-emptive action; substitute a stated numeric tolerance if objected to in prosecution.

findings.title: Dangling final clause in claim 1
findings.attack: The shape-recovery clause is not framed as a fourth named state parallel to the preceding three, creating ambiguity about its status.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Insert a lead-in phrase making the parallel structure explicit.

corrections.from_text: The valve core of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein...
corrections.to: Split into a range excluding claims 8/9 combined, plus separate singly-dependent claims from claim 8 and claim 9.
corrections.reason: F-37-1: claims 8 and 9 are themselves multiply dependent.

corrections.from_text: The valve core of any one of claims 18 to 21, wherein...
corrections.to: Restructure once claims 18 and 21 are corrected so the range excludes multiply dependent claims.

corrections.from_text: The valve core of any one of claims 1 to 17, wherein...
corrections.to: Restructure so the range 1-17 is not used as a single back-reference for a further multiple dependent claim.

corrections.from_text: each currently a multiple dependent claim whose range includes an intervening multiply dependent claim
corrections.to: apply the same restructuring pattern shown for claims 10, 18 and 22 throughout

corrections.from_text: on a side on which the poppet bears in over-travel
corrections.to: on a side which the poppet contacts to produce the radial deflection in over-travel
corrections.reason: F-37-2: removes reliance on unsupported antecedent "bears."
F-37-3: numeral conflicts with claim 9's wiper ring (132).

corrections.from_text: the deflectable ring element undergoing shape recovery to its at-rest form and closing the purge gap when the pressure differential falls below the over-travel threshold.
corrections.to: ; and on the pressure differential falling below the over-travel threshold, the deflectable ring element undergoing shape recovery to its at-rest form and closing the purge gap.
corrections.reason: F-37-7: clarifies this is a distinct recited condition.

assumptions.text: Reference numerals in the claims are assumed to carry interpretive weight absent an express disclaimer in the description.
The multiple-dependent-claim rule is assumed to apply in substance identically across US, EPO and UK practice.
Claim 66's alternative categories are counted only within F-37-1; no separate unity finding is made here.

open_questions.text: Whether the cascading multiple-dependency drafting style is deliberate and should be resequenced with claim-fee strategy.
Whether [0025]'s definition of "inflatable chamber" should be broadened or claim 64 narrowed instead.
